tools.name: size_loan
tools.description: Size a commercial real estate loan from first principles. Returns the maximum supportable loan as the MINIMUM of four constraints — loan-to-value, debt-service-coverage, debt yield and loan-to-cost — plus which one binds. Deterministic math on the numbers you supply; it does not quote lender terms.

tools.name: run_scenario
tools.description: Run what-if loan sizing across a range of assumptions: a rate ladder, an NOI sensitivity table, or the feasibility of a target loan amount against each constraint. Deterministic — same math as size_loan, swept.

tools.name: calculate_metrics
tools.description: Compute the standard commercial real estate underwriting metrics from raw figures: NOI, cap rate, DSCR, debt yield, LTV, LTC, operating expense ratio, break-even occupancy and yield on cost. Supply whatever you have — each metric is returned only when its inputs are present, with the formula used. U

tools.name: calculate_payment
tools.description: Amortizing and interest-only payment math for a commercial loan: monthly and annual debt service, total interest over the term, and the balloon balance at maturity when the term is shorter than the amortization (the normal CRE case — a 10-year term on a 30-year schedule).

tools.name: stress_test
tools.description: Stress a loan against rate shocks, income decline, and combined scenarios. Returns stressed DSCR per scenario with a pass/marginal/fail verdict — the same tests a credit committee runs. Rates are PERCENT (7.25 = 7.25%).

tools.name: estimate_closing_costs
tools.description: Itemize commercial closing costs for a New York or Florida transaction — lender, title, government (mortgage recording tax, transfer taxes) prepaid and third-party lines. tools.name: analyze_cash_out_refinance
tools.description: Full cash-out refinance waterfall: the largest new loan the property supports across LTV, DSCR and debt-yield, then down through payoff, prepayment penalty and closing costs to net cash in hand. tools.name: compare_loan_offers
tools.description: Rank competing loan offers by true cost of capital, not headline rate. Accounts for origination, exit and other fees over the actual term, and returns an effective rate, total cost and fee burden in basis points for each — so a 'cheaper' rate with heavy fees sorts correctly.

tools.name: search_cre_knowledge
tools.description: Search Relendi's curated commercial-real-estate knowledge base — lending concepts, deal lifecycle, typical fees and timelines. Returns source-cited excerpts. Use it to ground CRE answers rather than relying on memory.

tools.name: ask_cre_question
tools.description: Ask a plain-English question about commercial real estate lending and get a short answer grounded in Relendi's knowledge base, with citations. For loan math prefer size_loan or run_scenario, which are exact.

tools.name: prepare_deal
tools.description: Prepare a Move this deal to Relendi link from the user's CRE scenario. Use when the user wants to keep a deal, continue in Relendi, or carry property details beyond a calculator.
